quote.text: The Good stands before us like an archer’s target. Evil is not a thing in itself but a missing of the mark, an arrow gone astray.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • The good—your guiding principle as a parent—is like an archer’s target; let it shape your actions so that every lesson you impart points your children toward virtue.
    • When mistakes occur—a misdirected arrow—view them not as failures, but as opportunities to learn and gently steer your loved ones back toward the right path.
  • Leadership
    • A leader, like a steady archer, must set a clear vision of the “good” and align team efforts to hit that target; clarity in purpose inspires unity and decisive action.
    • Missteps in leadership—arrows that stray—should be embraced as chances to reflect, adjust strategy, and foster resilience and growth within both yourself and your team.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, envision your ultimate goal as the unwavering target; maintaining focus on quality and customer value ensures each decision is a step toward producing the good.
    • If a project veers off course, treat it as a misdirected arrow—an indicator to recalibrate processes, learn from oversights, and realign efforts to hit the mark next time.
